name: How long does fiber cement siding typically last before needing repairs?

mainEntity.name: How long does fiber cement siding typically last before needing repairs?

acceptedAnswer.text: Fiber cement siding is renowned for its durability, often lasting 30 to 50 years or even longer with proper installation and maintenance. However, factors like extreme weather exposure, inadequate initial installation, or impact damage can necessitate repairs sooner. Regular inspections help identify minor issues before they escalate, prolonging the lifespan of your siding and avoiding extensive repair work.
acceptedAnswer.description: Fiber cement siding can last 30-50 years, but repairs might be needed sooner due to weather, installation, or damage.
